title_en: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Nine
body_ar: كتاب "طبقات الحنابلة" لأبي يعلى وذيله لابنه ، وذيله كذلك لابن الجوزي ، ومن المتأخرين كتاب "السحب الوابلة على برائح الحنابلة" وهذا مختص بالوفيات ونحو ذلك. ثم الطبقات المختصة بعلم آخر كطبقات القراء ، فقد ألف فيه عدد من الكتب ، قد ألف الحافظ الذهبي كتابه "طبقات القراء الكبار" ، وألف الداودي كتاب "طبقات المفسرين" ، والسيوطي كذلك "طبقات المفسرين" ، والسيوطي قد اختصر تذكرة الحفاظ للذهبي في كتابه "طبقات الحفاظ" في الحديث ، وهو مجرد اختصار لكتاب الذهبي ، وإن كان قد وضع على كتاب الذهبي عدد من "الذيول" ككتاب ابن النجار ثم كتاب السيوطي الذي ترجم فيه لنفسه ، ولعدد من معاصريه.
body_en: The book Tabaqat al-Hanabilah by Abu Ya'la, and its continuation (dhayl) by his son, and likewise its continuation by Ibn al-Jawzi. Among the later scholars, the book al-Suhub al-Wabilah 'ala Bara'ih al-Hanabilah — this one is devoted to dates of death and the like. Then there are the works of biographical classes (ṭabaqāt) devoted to some other science, such as the classes of the Qur'an reciters: a number of books have been written on it. The ḥāfiẓ al-Dhahabi wrote his book Tabaqat al-Qurra' al-Kibar; al-Dawudi wrote the book Tabaqat al-Mufassirin, and al-Suyuti likewise Tabaqat al-Mufassirin. Al-Suyuti abridged al-Dhahabi's Tadhkirat al-Huffaz in his book Tabaqat al-Huffaz on hadith, and it is no more than an abridgement of al-Dhahabi's book — though a number of continuations have been placed upon al-Dhahabi's book, such as the book of Ibn al-Najjar, then the book of al-Suyuti, in which he gave an entry for himself and for a number of his contemporaries.

translator_notes: A bibliographical survey of the ṭabaqāt (biographical-classes) literature, part of a course lesson. No legal ruling appears anywhere in it, so none of the five-rulings vocabulary applies.
Book titles are left in romanised Arabic rather than translated, since they function as citations; 'dhayl' is glossed as 'continuation' on first occurrence.
